Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 53: the slip of [[Enhanced Proton Torpedoes (V)|Enhanced Proton Torpedoes (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Use 1 Force to deploy on your starfighter. May target a starship for free. Draw destiny (If on a Heroic starfighter, may first use 1 Force to add 3 to total). Target hit if total destiny > defense value.”), word for word the text of [[Enhanced Proton Torpedoes (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
